en.description: Affinda is a leading provider of AI-powered document parsing and data extraction solutions. Their advanced technology enables businesses to automate the extraction of critical data from various documents, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The company's flagship product, the resume parser, helps organizations streamline their recruitment processes by accurately extracting information from resumes.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to achieve top rankings for the keyword "resume parser" on Google to increase visibility and attract more customers.
Affinda faced strong competition from established players in the document parsing industry, making it difficult to secure top rankings.
The market for resume parsers is highly competitive, with numerous companies vying for the same keywords.
Affinda needed an effective SEO strategy that could deliver results within a limited budget.

1. Comprehensive SEO Audit
Conducted a thorough audit of Affinda's website to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, and backlink opportunities.

2. Keyword Optimization
Focused on optimizing on-page elements, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and content, for the keyword "resume parser".

3. High-Quality Content Creation
Developed in-depth, high-quality content around the keyword "resume parser" to establish Affinda as an authority in the field.

4. Link Building
Implemented a targeted link-building campaign to acquire high-quality backlinks from relevant, authoritative websites in the AI, technology, and recruitment industries.
5. Key Link Building Postulates

• Publish content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit focused on AI, technology, and recruitment.

  • Ensure publications are on websites with at least two of three criteria: Domain Rating (DR) 50+, Organic Traffic 1000+ with relevant traffic, and reputable TLDs.

  • Maintain a consistent link velocity to match the growth of competitors.

  • Keep all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: With a clear strategy in place, the execution involved:

nodes.value: Enhanced existing content and created new content targeting the keyword "resume parser."
Conducted targeted outreach to secure backlinks from high-authority sites, leveraging relationships with industry influencers and publications.
Fixed identified technical issues, such as site speed, mobile usability, and structured data, to improve overall site performance and search engine visibility.

en.results_description: The combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: Achieved the top position on Google for the keyword "resume parser," surpassing established competitors. This success was validated by the Ahrefs data showing Affinda ranking #1.
Substantial increase in organic traffic, from approximately 11,000 visitors to 28,000 visitors, representing a 2.5x growth.
Increased the number of high-quality referring domains significantly over the campaign period - from 39 referring domains in March 2023 to 142 in July 2023.
Maintained high-quality backlinks, which remained active and continued to provide SEO benefits. We built high-quality links from reputable sites, including Upwork, Entrepreneur, and HubSpot.

conclusion_content.title: All external links built by our team remain active, ensuring that our clients continue to benefit from their investments.

en.title: My Baskets

seo.title: My Baskets SEO Success | How Link Building Increased Traffic
seo.description: Learn how Heroic Rankings elevated My Baskets' organic traffic through strategic outreach and high-authority backlinks, strengthening their position in the online gift industry.

en.service_featured_title: Increased organic traffic by 200% and sales by 150% in 12 months.

nodes.value: By implementing a comprehensive SEO strategy including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content marketing, we helped My Baskets achieve significant growth in organic traffic and sales.

en.description: My Baskets is a leading Canadian online retailer specializing in luxury gift baskets for various occasions. The website offers a wide range of themed baskets, including gourmet food, wine, baby gifts, and corporate gifts, ensuring a premium gifting experience for every customer.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to regain top rankings for major keywords like "gift baskets Toronto," "gift baskets Canada," and "gourmet gift baskets Canada," after noticing a significant drop in positions due to increased competition.
My Baskets had stable positions at 2 and 3 for major keywords but dropped below position 20 by spring 2023.
Competitors aggressively built new links, and previous link-building efforts were ineffective due to poor quality and relevance.
The budget limited the ability to match competitors' link output, necessitating a strategic approach.
To address these challenges within the budget constraints, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Anchor Text Audit and Optimization
Conducted a thorough audit of internal and external anchor text portfolios to align with targeted anchor text distribution for the homepage and internal collection pages.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: Due to budget limitations, the team focused on:

nodes.value: Utilized Screaming Frog, Ahrefs anchor text report, and in- house Python scripts to audit and flag anchor types, revealing over optimization with 35% exact match anchors.
Created a dynamic spreadsheet with array formulas to track anchor text distribution, internal link opportunities and their implementation progress.
The client's in-house team implemented internal links following the strategy, syncing efforts with our team using the spreadsheet.
Built five high-quality backlinks per month while the client's team added up to 30 internal links to maintain the ratio.
We implemented our own Python scripts to run automated health checks for each link built on a weekly basis in order to ensure it’s longevity for over 11 months.

en.results_description: Despite competitors' higher link output, the combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 2 by October 2023, surpassing bloomex.ca and baskits.com.
From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, outranking bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.
From fluctuating and disappearing from the top 20 in summer 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, competing strongly with bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.

results_cards.title: Googlebot in refresh mode visits have become more frequent and stable

Due to external link daisy chaining we’ve managed to keep new backlink indexation to above 80% within its first month of publishing, whereas it’s a common industry standard for it to be ~60% within the first three months of publishing

Due to automated backlink health checks with our internal Python scripts, we’ve never lost a single link for more than 48 hours keeping it within the index at all times. Our total link loss for this client was less than 0.5% within 11 months, whereas industry standard can be anywhere between 35%-60% within first six month of their publication.

nodes.value: Anchor text distribution optimization played a crucial role when external link building was limited.
By maintaining quality standards and consistent link velocity growth, we improved the referring domain average DR distribution, keeping an edge over competitors.

conclusion_content.title: By following this structured approach, My Baskets successfully regained top positions for critical keywords, demonstrating the effectiveness of strategic link- building and anchor text optimization.

nodes.value: All external links built by our team remain active, ensuring that our clients continue to benefit from their investments.

This project exemplifies how precise, strategic actions and full collaboration between the client’s team and our in-house experts can achieve outstanding results, even without the initially anticipated budget, by adhering to best practices rather than outspending the competition.

full_content.value:
What can you do today to help your business grow? How can you stay competitive? Can you improve your processes and efficiency? If you are asking yourself these questions it’s time to consider custom business software. A solution made only for you and with you in mind.

Sounds great, but is it really worth it? Data shows that by next year, the custom software development industry will generate $507.2 billion in revenue. This means custom software development is on the rise.

If this number is not enough to convince you, we have prepared 10 key benefits of custom software that you can’t afford to miss. Let’s start!
What is Custom Business Software?

Custom business software is a customized software solution built for a specific business. It is developed to address unique requests and demands that are uncommon and connected to a single business, niche, or industry.

Unlike most generic solutions, custom solutions are not a one-size-fits-all kind of product. This means that these tailored software solutions are built to fit a current system and business processes that need improving. Because of their personalized approach, custom business software solutions are not only what the business needs but also what it can grow with.

They work great for small businesses as well as enterprise-level companies so your business size or business goals won’t be in the way. What makes them so great is that they are easy to advertise and package as products for other similar businesses. To fully realize your project’s potential, partnering with a reliable custom software development company is essential like “brigit.dev”.
Examples of Custom Software Solutions

• Docebo: E-learning platform for businesses

  • TraceLink: Supply chain management for pharmaceuticals

  • Kareo: Medical practice management software

  • PastPerfect: Museum management software

  • Envirosuite: Environmental monitoring software
Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software

image.alt_text: Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software
image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401e9f1ebcf9aac6941d04/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png

full_content.value:
Custom business software and off-the-shelf solutions are different at their core. Custom software is designed for a particular business, while off-the-shelf solutions are intended for a broad range of users. While your business can benefit from both, only custom software solutions can help your business grow. Custom software

Here are the differences that show why:

1. Custom software

    • personalized approach

    • adaptable

    • not available to everyone

    • easy to scale and add new features

  2. Off-the-shelf software

    • built for a mass audience

    • can't be adapted or changed

    • immediately available

    • little or no room for scalability
To show you how these differences translate into real benefits, here's a list of key advantages custom software development can bring you.
10 Key Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth
1. Personalization for your unique needs

Custom software is designed to fit your specific needs. It addresses your unique processes and workflows. It also makes sure that the software works just the way you need it to. This means you get features that directly support your business and improve efficiency and effective use.
2. Higher return on investment

Custom software provides a higher return on investment over time. Because it’s custom-built according to you it can save money in the long run. It helps avoid extra costs associated with adapting off-the-shelf solutions to fit your business.

Additionally, it improves your work and speeds up your progress. It also makes you one step ahead of everyone on the market, because you need very detailed and specific industry expertise to make it. This makes you an industry leader and you can profit from this knowledge.
3. Competitive advantage

Custom software gives you a competitive edge because it keeps you ahead of the game. Your competition probably isn’t investing in solutions like these. They don’t have the time, money, or the expertise to do it. Everyone wants a quick solution. This helps you become a leading name. You can then profit from this down the line and sell your solution to others. It will be easier to market and position yourself as an authority on this matter.
4. Easier scalability

Custom software can grow with your business. As your needs change or expand, the software can be adjusted to handle new challenges. This makes it easier to scale your operations without having to switch to a different system. This is one of the biggest benefits.
5. Increased security

Custom software can provide better security because it is built specifically for your business. It can for example include advanced security features tailored to your unique requirements. This helps protect your sensitive data from potential threats and breaches. With custom solutions security is guaranteed.
6. Selling and marketing potential

Custom software boosts your selling and marketing potential by offering a unique solution to specific market needs. This makes your product stand out and allows you to market it as a specialized tool with features not found in generic software. This easily sets you apart from competitors. It also gives you an even bigger return on the investment down the road.
7. Faster processes

With custom software, you can speed up your business processes. The software is made to match your specific workflow and help with performance optimization. It eliminates unnecessary steps and reduces time spent on tasks. This means your team can work more quickly and productively. Ultimately it leads to faster completion of projects and services.
8. Reliable support and maintenance

Custom software usually comes with reliable support and maintenance. Since the software is built specifically for your business, you can work closely with the development team to address any issues or updates. This ensures that the software remains up-to-date and functions smoothly. It also minimizes downtime and disruptions.
9. Seamless integration

Custom software can be easily integrated with your existing systems, including legacy systems, to improve overall efficiency. It is designed to work seamlessly with other tools and applications you use to reduce compatibility issues. Easy integration doesn’t affect your workflow and avoids the complications of using incompatible software.
10. Longevity

Custom software can have a longer lifespan compared to off-the-shelf solutions. It can be updated and modified as your business grows and changes, extending its usefulness. This long-term adaptability means you won’t need to replace the software very often. It saves time and money in the long run.
Main Disadvantages of Custom Software Development You Should Consider

Custom solutions come with many benefits that most definitely outweigh the possible drawbacks. However, it’s important to know these three disadvantages to prepare and use the full potential of custom software development.
1. Time to deliver

Each phase requires a lot of attention to make sure that the software meets all requirements. This extended development period can seem long and tiring. But you must be prepared to wait and know that in the end, your business will benefit greatly from it.

Also, choosing the right custom software development partner can make the development process quicker and better.

3. Initial costs

full_content.value:
We don’t want to scare you, but we won’t hide this fact from you. The initial costs of custom software development can be quite high. Building software from scratch involves a lot of expenses for design, development, and testing. We know that this might be a barrier for many. Although the price is not always that high.

Custom software development for small businesses is a lot smaller than for custom enterprise software development. Also, it’s important to note that the long-term benefits outweigh the initial costs and bring a high return on investment.
The Bottom Line

Custom software development comes with many advantages. While the initial investment and longer development time might seem challenging, the benefits outweigh these concerns in the long run.

It is a strategic investment that brings business growth. By focusing on your specific needs, it contributes to the long-term success of your business. So if you want to stay relevant and grow your business in 2026 custom software development is necessary.
